extName.description: The extension's name in the browser and stores. Don't translate.

extDescription.message: Aprende palabras mientras navegas: cambia palabras de las páginas web por las que estás aprendiendo, en cualquier idioma.
extDescription.description: The extension's one-line description on the browser's extensions page.

ui_locale.description: The code of this translation, the same as its folder name (en, es, pt_BR). Not shown; used to format numbers, plurals and language names.

action_title.description: Toolbar button tooltip when Kotiko is on.

action_title_off.description: Toolbar button tooltip when Kotiko is off everywhere.

action_title_paused.description: Toolbar button tooltip on a paused site. $HOST$ is the site, like example.com.

badge_off.description: Tiny badge text on the toolbar icon when Kotiko is off or paused. Keep it to 3 characters or fewer.

popup_add_placeholder.message: Agrega una palabra, en cualquier idioma
popup_add_placeholder.description: Placeholder in the popup's add box.

popup_add_label.description: Accessible name of the popup's add box.

popup_add_submit.description: Accessible name of the small button at the end of the add box (Enter does the same).

popup_switch_label.description: Accessible name of the master switch in the popup header.

popup_switch_on.description: Visible state of the master switch when Kotiko is on.

popup_switch_off.description: Visible state of the master switch when Kotiko is off.

popup_settings.description: Settings button in the popup header, and the settings view's title.

popup_offline.description: Small label in the popup header when the computer is offline.

popup_loading.description: Accessible label while the popup reads its data (normally under 100 ms).

popup_first_run_title.description: Title of the first-run card in the popup.

popup_first_run_body.message: Conecta tu servidor de Kotiko y agrega tu primera palabra, en cualquier idioma. Toma menos de un minuto.
popup_first_run_body.description: Body of the first-run card while Kotiko needs a server (until the welcome tab ships).

popup_empty.message: Aún no hay palabras. Escribe una arriba, en cualquier idioma.
popup_empty.description: Shown in the popup when the word list is empty.

popup_languages_title.description: Section title above the language chips.

popup_chip_name_hidden_one.description: Accessible name of a language chip that is off, for one word.

popup_chip_name_hidden_other.description: Accessible name of a language chip that is off, for several words.

popup_only_button.description: The small button at the end of a language chip that hides every other language.

popup_only_strip.description: Line above the chips when only one of several languages is shown.

popup_show_all.description: Link that shows every language again.

popup_more_languages.description: Button after the first chips when there are many languages.

popup_fewer_languages.description: Button that collapses the long language list again.

popup_lang_keys_hint.message: Las flechas mueven, Espacio muestra u oculta, F muestra solo este idioma
popup_lang_keys_hint.description: Keyboard help read by screen readers on the language chips.

popup_this_page.description: Title of the section about the current site. $HOST$ is the site, like example.com.

popup_pause_site.description: Switch label in the This page section.

popup_paused_on.description: Shown instead of the pause switch on a paused site.

popup_resume.description: Button that resumes Kotiko on a paused site.

popup_off_banner.message: Kotiko está desactivado en todos los sitios.
popup_off_banner.description: Banner when the master switch is off.

popup_word_count_one.description: Popup footer: how many words you have, one.

popup_word_count_other.description: Popup footer: how many words you have, several.

popup_not_connected_one.message: Kotiko no está conectado a un servidor, así que no puede buscar palabras nuevas. Tu palabra sigue funcionando en las páginas.
popup_not_connected_one.description: Banner when no server is set up but some words are cached, one word.

popup_not_connected_other.message: Kotiko no está conectado a un servidor, así que no puede buscar palabras nuevas. Tus $COUNT$ palabras siguen funcionando en las páginas.
popup_not_connected_other.description: Banner when no server is set up but some words are cached, several words.

add_looking_up.description: Line under the add box while a word is being looked up. $TEXT$ is what you typed.

add_created.description: A word was added. $NATIVE$ is the word, $PRONUNCIATION$ how to say it, $GLOSS$ its meaning, $LANG$ its language. "Agregada" agrees with "palabra".

add_created_plain.description: As add_created, when there is no pronunciation.

add_undo_label.description: Accessible name of the Undo button.

add_dismiss.description: Accessible name of the button that clears a failed line.

undo_failed.description: After Undo failed. $MESSAGE$ is one of the error messages.

settings_back.description: Button that leaves the settings view.

settings_connection_help.message: Kotiko obtiene tus palabras de tu propio servidor de Kotiko.

settings_server_address.description: Label of the server address field.

settings_access_key.description: Label of the field for the server's access key.

settings_access_key_help.message: La clave con la que se configuró tu servidor de Kotiko.
settings_access_key_help.description: Help under the access key field.

settings_show_key.description: Button that shows the access key as text.

settings_hide_key.description: Button that hides the access key again.

settings_check_now.description: Button that checks the server right away.

settings_checking.description: Status while Kotiko contacts the server.

settings_connected_one.message: Conexión correcta. Tu servidor tiene $COUNT$ palabra.
settings_connected_one.description: Status after a good connection, one word.

settings_connected_other.message: Conexión correcta. Tu servidor tiene $COUNT$ palabras.
settings_connected_other.description: Status after a good connection, several words.

settings_last_checked.description: When the server was last reached. $TIME$ is like "3 minutes ago" / "hace 3 minutos".

error_details.description: Expander with technical details under an error.

error_permission_missing_action.description: Button that asks the browser for permission to read pages.

error_permission_missing.message: Kotiko necesita permiso para leer las páginas y cambiar palabras.
error_permission_missing.description: Banner when the browser hasn't given Kotiko access to pages.

error_server_unreachable_one.message: No se puede contactar tu servidor de Kotiko. Tu palabra sigue funcionando en las páginas; podrás agregar nuevas cuando vuelva.
error_server_unreachable_one.description: The server doesn't answer; one word is cached.

error_server_unreachable_other.message: No se puede contactar tu servidor de Kotiko. Tus $COUNT$ palabras siguen funcionando en las páginas; podrás agregar nuevas cuando vuelva.
error_server_unreachable_other.description: The server doesn't answer; several words are cached.

error_server_unreachable_empty.message: No se puede contactar tu servidor de Kotiko. Podrás agregar palabras cuando vuelva.
error_server_unreachable_empty.description: The server doesn't answer and no words are cached.

error_server_key_rejected.message: Tu servidor de Kotiko no aceptó la clave de acceso. Pégala de nuevo en los ajustes de conexión.
error_server_key_rejected.description: The server answered that the access key is wrong.

error_server_address_invalid.message: Esa dirección de servidor no parece correcta. Prueba una como http://localhost:4747.
error_server_address_invalid.description: The server address can't be used as typed. Keep the example address as it is.

error_not_kotiko_server.message: Algo respondió en esa dirección, pero no es un servidor de Kotiko. Revisa la dirección.
error_not_kotiko_server.description: The address answered with something other than Kotiko's word list.

error_internal.message: Algo salió mal en Kotiko. Inténtalo de nuevo; si sigue pasando, avísanos.
error_internal.description: Any failure without a more specific message.

error_unsupported_page.message: Kotiko no puede funcionar en páginas del navegador como esta.
error_unsupported_page.description: In the This page section on browser pages (settings, new tab, stores).

error_add_not_connected.message: Conecta tu servidor de Kotiko para agregar palabras.
error_add_not_connected.description: An add failed because no server is set up.

error_add_offline.message: Estás sin conexión. Agrégala de nuevo cuando vuelvas.
error_add_offline.description: An add failed while the computer is offline.

error_lookup_failed.message: La búsqueda de palabras no respondió. Inténtalo de nuevo en un momento.
error_lookup_failed.description: The server couldn't look the word up.

error_save_failed.message: Tu servidor de Kotiko no pudo guardar esa palabra. Inténtalo de nuevo.
error_save_failed.description: The server looked the word up but couldn't save it.

error_no_word_found.message: No se encontró ninguna palabra en “$TEXT$”. Prueba con la palabra sola.
error_no_word_found.description: The lookup found no word. $TEXT$ is what you typed.

error_input_too_long.message: Es mucho texto para una palabra. Prueba con una palabra o una frase corta.
error_input_too_long.description: The add box text is over 200 characters.

add_already_known.description: After adding words the learner already had; no Undo is offered.
